name: rose_window
description: Rose window (哥特玫瑰窗) generator: radial-symmetric traceried round window — outer frame ring (circle_ring) + N spokes + centre hub + stained-glass infill (disc), all circles from patterns/ellipse.py (圆算法单一来源). The window sits IN the wall: blocks replace the wall skin at v=0 and explicit minecraft:air cells carve a `depth`-deep opening into the wall behind (air 开凿学 dormer). 算法 = Grafix Arts/UCLA 玫瑰窗画法 (同心圆环 + 360°/N 径向阵列). All geometry script-derived; no stair/slab states involved.
when_to_use: 哥特教堂西立面/袖廊端墙、 chapel 后殿圆窗; gothic_cathedral 必备。origin = 窗心格(墙外皮层), y = 窗心层; facing = 墙外法线(窗朝向)。radius≥5 才有花瓣感; 小堂用 3-4。

origin.notes: 窗心格(墙外皮层); y = 窗心层, 窗体上下各展 radius 格

radius.notes: 外圈半径(格); 直径=2r+1 全奇数

glass_material.notes: 玻璃填充; 彩色玻璃 *_stained_glass

depth.notes: 向墙内开凿窗洞深度; 厚墙设 2-3

pitfalls: 窗洞必须切进墙里 —— 输出里的 minecraft:air 单元就是干这个的(打通墙面), 禁止删; 没有 place_air 能力时先手工挖掉对应墙块再放置
origin 必须取墙外皮层的窗心格 —— 偏 1 格整窗偏心, 辐条不对称; y 取窗心层不是窗下沿
depth 要配墙厚 —— 1 格墙 depth=1; 厚墙 depth<墙厚时窗后是实墙不透光, depth>墙厚会打穿内墙装饰
spokes 取 4/8/12/16 才均分圆; 奇数辐条视觉上总有一根不正, 哥特做法全是偶数
radius=3 时毂(disc 1)已占满内圈, 几乎无玻璃 —— 想要花窗效果 radius≥5
example: python patterns/rose_window.py --params '{"origin":[100,80,100],"facing":"south","radius":5}' --out rose1.json && python patterns/rose_window.py --params '{"origin":[140,84,100],"facing":"east","radius":7,"spokes":12,"glass_material":"minecraft:blue_stained_glass","depth":2}' --out rose2.json
